entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: A vast forest growing inside the corpse of a titan from the Dawning Age, in the Northwest Region of Orrithia on Arcavios.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane on which Titan's Grave is located.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: A college whose students seek new flora and fauna at Titan's Grave for use in alchemy.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: An oracle who disappeared in 4565 AR and was abducted by an archaic.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A student who investigated the activity beneath Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A student who investigated the activity beneath Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A student who forced Jadzi into the nexus and followed; her actions are left unexplained.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A student who investigated the activity beneath Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A student who investigated the activity beneath Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who joined the students' investigation and intervened to stop Chandra from destroying the archaic.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who came into conflict with the students and sought the archaic's destruction.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A group whose renegade former members clashed with the investigators.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: A species of spirit endemic to the titan that helped the students complete Jadzi's spell.

events.summary: Anomalous archaic activity beneath Titan's Grave and the disappearance of Jadzi raise tensions in 4565 AR.
events.quote: escalating tensions followed the discovery of anomalous archaic activity beneath Titan's Grave and the disappearance of the oracle Jadzi

events.summary: The students and Ajani Goldmane investigate and come into conflict with Chandra Nalaar and renegade former Oriq.
events.quote: brought them into conflict with Chandra Nalaar and a renegade group of former Oriq

events.summary: Chandra seeks the archaic's destruction and Ajani intervenes to prevent it.
events.quote: Chandra sought its destruction, and Ajani intervened to prevent it

events.summary: Tamira forces Jadzi into the nexus and follows.
events.quote: Tamira forced Jadzi into the nexus and followed

events.summary: The remaining students, aided by lumarets, complete Jadzi's spell, stabilizing the archaic and halting the distortions.
events.quote: completed Jadzi's interrupted spell, stabilizing the archaic and halting the distortions
